name: forge
description: Sixty-five command-invoked toolkits in one plugin, sorted into ten categories: WordPress engineering, design and frontend, writing and content, DevOps and data, cloud and architecture, security, code cleanup, code, docs and diagrams, and utilities. Every toolkit is reached through an explicit slash command - nothing auto-triggers, so none of these procedures can fire on their own or collide with other installed skills. Each command loads its own procedure file from lib/<name>/SKILL.md on invocation and pulls bundled references, scripts, and assets from the same folder. Run /forge for a category-then-item picker across the whole catalog, or jump to one category with /forge-wordpress, /forge-design, /forge-writing, /forge-devops, /forge-cloud, /forge-security, /forge-cleanup, /forge-code, /forge-docs, /forge-utils, or call any tool directly: /wp-plugin, /wp-build, /wp-theme, /wp-review, /wp-consult, /wp-format, /wp-menu-icons, /wp-report-card, /wp-grade, /wp-performance, /wp-demo, /wp-feature-readme, /html-design-styles, /accessibility-audit, /design-system, /tailwind-convert, /page-cloner, /page-tailwindify, /tech-blog-article, /tutorial-builder, /draft-contract, /name-domains, /language-tutor, /docker-compose-architect, /kubernetes-architect, /powershell-script-engine, /jq, /system-design, /terraform, /cicd-pipeline, /data-pipeline, /cloud-migration, /sre-audit, /finops, /incident-report, /threat-model, /devsecops, /pentest-report, /unslop, /strip-unicode, /strip-emoji, /strip-comments, /blueprint, /e2e-tests, /explain-my-code, /codebase-to-mermaid, /readme-builder, /changelog-generator, /refactor, /explain-sql, /docblock-rewrite, /code-teacher, /mermaid-to-ascii, /mermaid-sequence, /explain-prompt, /analyze-prompt, /rank-prompt, /prompt-rank-table, /prompt-stencil, /snippet, /session-stats, /token-audit, /vgademo, /fix-formula, /crash-report.
